entities.name: Padeem
entities.description: A vedalken inventor of self-repairing armor, now Consul of Innovation among the Enlightened Keepers.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Body that funds projects and presents Padeem as a judge of the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Enlightened Keepers
entities.description: Group among whom Padeem sits as Consul of Innovation.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: Fair at which Padeem is a judge.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: Introduced her teleporter at the fair via Saheeli's audience.

events.summary: In her youth Padeem becomes renowned as an artificer-duelist for inventing self-repairing armor.
Saheeli gets an audience with Padeem so Rashmi can present her teleporter at the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: Saheeli got an audience with Padeem

relations.note: Sits among them as Consul of Innovation.
relations.quote: Padeem sits among the Enlightened Keepers as Consul of Innovation
